summary: RFID temperature sensor tags combine a UHF RFID chip with an integrated temperature sensor — logging ambient temperature at programmable intervals and storing the data on-chip for wireless retrieval. Monitor cold chain compliance for pharmaceuticals, food, biologics and chemicals without batteries, wires or manual data loggers.
